text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Bright-chan! Nice run, that was a great 
fight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright...! Yeah...! We gave it everything 
we had!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright demonstrated her true 
qualities to the fullest on the wide 
track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My worries were unfounded. As expected, no 
unexpected formidable rivals appeared...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what did you think of my move 
back there~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I thought I made my move at the absolute 
best moment, but, um...
choice_data_list: You did the right thing, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~ I'm feeling 
exceptionally light on my feet right now~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without being overwhelmed by the grand 
stage of the Japanese Derby, Mejiro Bright 
ran the best race she possibly could.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah, Lady Suzuka~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good day~. I am so glad we could spend 
this glorious day together~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Let's see... But more importantly...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Watching you today made me realize 
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You noticed...? Y-Yes~. What might it be~?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"You stayed true to your own running 
style. That's why you can make such a 
happy face... But..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have that kind of look on my 
face. It's not about whether I can win or 
not..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Whether we were able to run the way our 
hearts truly desired. You did, and I 
couldn't... That's why...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta... break through this place. 
Break through here— and go see the scenery 
I truly wanted to see.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because if I don't do that, I won't be 
able to truly be me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've finally made up my mind. I just 
wanted to say thank you for that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"See you later, Bright. It probably won't 
be at the Kikuka Sho, but if we can meet 
again somewhere, someday..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, Suzuka-sama...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-sama?
choice_data_list:
Looks like it was a great learning 
experience, for Suzuka too.

Looks like it was a great learning 
experience, for Suzuka too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Mejiro Bright run must have 
stirred some deep thoughts within her. The 
Derby held a different meaning for each of 
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the next one is the Kikuka Sho, 
is it not~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
While I do love small, delicate flowers, I 
am quite fond of chrysanthemums as well, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at it fills me with such a 
splendid, proud feeling. A feeling like, 
'Aren't you quite grand~?'
choice_data_list:
Are you sure we shouldn't consider any 
path other than the Kikuka Sho?

Is it fine if we don't think about paths 
other than the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just to ask: in the autumn of the Classic 
year, some Umamusume choose to take the 
middle-distance route instead of running 
the long-distance Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Nothing other than the Kikuka-sho—is 
acceptable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What matters most to the Mejiro family are 
prestigious races like the Tenno Sho and 
the Classic Triple Crown. And...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The only things I desire are the things 
that Mejiro desires, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright's dream remains unwavering. 
From here, let's make the necessary 
preparations with our sights set on the 
Kikuka Sho.
